item.title: commandline: PyRIT: Democratizing AI red teaming through open-source tooling
item.description:
PyRIT is presented as an open-source Python tool for AI red teaming that lowers the barrier for subject matter experts to test generative AI systems. The article describes its evolution toward making red teaming more accessible across many domains.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
